info.title: PRINT-ONCE-001 bounded API supplement
info.description: 2026-10-15 authorized error-contract correction: preserves existing runtime and original controlled-printing 422 compliance mapping. 409 is reserved for existing version/state-transition conflicts; direct-PDF behavior unchanged.

post.description: Existing print:document:generate and original business read/formal checks unchanged. Returns current rendered PDF directly; creates no print-result records. Existing historical GET remains immutable/read-only.

403.description: Existing business or print permission denied

409.description: Existing concurrent version/source-target conflict or state-transition conflict; no print result persisted

422.description: PRINT_STATE_INVALID: inactive, unbound or incompatible template; existing formal approval/signature compliance rejection; PDF integrity/conversion/output compliance failure. No print result persisted

400.description: Invalid request shape, IDs, duplicate selection or incompatible output/formal parameters

404.description: Referenced business record or template does not exist in the authorized scope
